Privacy Policy

‍

‍
Effective Date: October 16, 2026

At FRESHR, protecting your personal data is our priority.
‍
Whether you use the platform Arcads (the "Platform") as our client (the “Client”) and as part of the management of our contractual relations with our Client, we may collect personal data about you.
The purpose of this policy is to inform you about how we process your personal data in compliance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data (hereinafter the "GDPR") and French Data Protection Law n° 78-17 of 6 January 1978 (together the "Applicable Regulations").

1. Who is the data controller?
The data controller is FRESHR, joint-stock company, registered with the Registry of Trade and Companies of Rouen under the number 832 905 327 and whose head office is located at 27 Rue Alfred Kastler, Mont Saint Aignan, 76130 France (“Us” or “We”) when browsing on our Platform or when using your account on our Platform as our Client.
‍
2. What personal data we collect?
Personal data is a data that identifies an individual directly or indirectly, in particular by reference to an identifier such as a name.
‍
We may collect the following personal data:

Identification data (e.g. full name, email addresses);
‍Data relating to your professional life (e.g : company name, position/function, company size, company website, logo);
‍Data relating to your orders;
‍Login data (e.g. logs, IP address);
If you choose to sign in using a third-party authentication service (e.g., Google or Microsoft), certain data such as your name and email may be collected from that service. By choosing this method, you agree that the service may share this information with us. We do not collect your third-party account password;
Browsing data (IP address, pages viewed, date and time of connection, browser used, operating system, user ID);
‍Location data;
‍Data related to recordings from telephone calls with our customer care service (e.g. content of the calls, dates of the calls);
‍Economic and financial data (e.g. bank details);
Data related to your credit cards.
Any information you wish to send us as part of your contact request.
If you choose to connect Google Drive to the Platform, data related to the integration and the use of the feature (e.g. Google account email address, encrypted authentication tokens, connection status, selected folder identifiers, file identifiers, file names, mime types, file metadata such as size and duration, and files or content that you explicitly choose to import from or export/upload to Google Drive). If you designate a Google Drive folder as a b-roll library, we also read metadata about video files in that folder (such as file names, paths, mime types, size, and duration) to index your library; we do not download those files unless you explicitly import them.
If you choose to connect Dropbox to the Platform, data related to the integration and the use of the feature (e.g. Dropbox account email address, encrypted authentication tokens, connection status, selected folder identifiers or paths, file identifiers, file names, mime types, file metadata such as size and duration, and files or content that you explicitly choose to import from or export/upload to Dropbox, including where you configure automated workflows to export or upload content to Dropbox). If you designate a Dropbox folder as a b-roll library, we also read metadata about video files in that folder (such as file names, paths, and media information) to index your library; we do not download those files unless you explicitly import them.
If you choose to connect TikTok to the Platform, data related to the integration and the use of the feature (e.g. your TikTok account identifier, username, display name and profile picture, connection status, the permissions you granted, encrypted authentication tokens, metadata about the videos published on your TikTok account, and, if you allow posting, the videos, captions and post settings you choose to publish to TikTok and the status of each publication).
If you choose to connect an X (formerly Twitter) account to the Platform, data related to the integration and the use of the feature (e.g. your X account identifier, username, display name, profile picture, follower count and verification status, encrypted authentication tokens, your posts and their public metrics, the advertising accounts and campaign statistics you choose to view, and the posts and media you choose to publish to X and the status of each publication).
If you choose to connect a TikTok for Business account to the Platform, data related to the integration and the use of the feature (e.g. the identifiers and names of the TikTok advertiser accounts you authorise, encrypted authentication tokens, the advertiser accounts you select for each brand, the identifiers, names, status, format and performance metrics of your ads, the TikTok posts used by your Spark Ads, the ads you choose to import, and the videos you choose to upload to your TikTok advertiser account and the status of each upload).

We inform you, when collecting your personal data, whether some of these data are mandatory or optional.

3. On what legal basis, for what purposes and for how long do we keep your personal data?

Objectives	Legal basis	Data retention period
To provide you with our services available on our Platform through your account	Performance of a contract to which you are party and/or taking steps at your request prior to entering into a contract	When you have created your account: personal data are retained for the duration of your account.Your connection logs are kept for 10 weeks. If your account is inactive for a period of 2 years, it will be deleted if you do not respond to our reactivation email.In addition, personal data may be archived for probationary purposes for a period of 5 yea
